results.query: Non-compliance with Section 65B certificate for electronic evidence admissibility

judgments.snippet: The court held that compliance with Section 65B(4) of the Indian Evidence Act is a pre-condition to the admissibility of electronic records as secondary evidence. The certificate requirement is mandatory and cannot be dispensed with by oral evidence…

judgments.case_name: Arjun Panditrao Khotkar vs. Kailash Kushanrao Gorantyal
judgments.snippet: A three-judge bench clarified the position on Section 65B certification, overruling prior confusion and holding that the certificate is required in all cases where electronic records are sought to be produced as evidence…

judgments.case_name: State of Maharashtra vs. Suresh Patil
judgments.snippet: The prosecution's failure to produce a Section 65B certificate for the CCTV footage rendered the electronic evidence inadmissible. The High Court held that the trial court erred in relying on this evidence without proper certification…
